description: Atin (2026-10-02): eliminate flaky tests rather than fix them. Delete the cases observed red on unrelated PRs during the c11 1.0 run: WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests timing/relay cases (15-32 s timeouts and crashes on main and PRs, evidence on C11-306), MessagesPageTests.testWriterMaxWaitRunsDuringSteadyTraffic (30 ms wait under load), and any other test the run recorded as flaky. Keep deterministic coverage of the same behavior where a cheap non-timing test already exists; otherwise delete outright and say so in the PR. Remove the Atlas gate exclusions once gone.
title: Delete flaky timing tests that block unrelated landings
